# YieldNest.online

> Independent Mutual Fund Research & Analytics Platform for Indian Equity & Debt Schemes.

YieldNest.online provides independent, quantitative, data-driven research on Indian Mutual Funds. Our articles analyze 3-year and 5-year rolling returns, downside capture ratios, standard deviation, portfolio overlap, expense ratio (TER) compounding drag, and AMFI India liquidity stress test disclosures.

We are strictly an investor education and quantitative research publication. Not registered with SEBI or AMFI; no financial advisory services, distributor commissions, or solicitation.

## Core Research Articles

- [AMFI Direct Plan Guide: What Are Direct Plans in Mutual Funds, How They Work, and How to Invest Directly](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/amfi-direct-plan-mutual-funds-guide-higher-returns-lower-expense-ratio): An exhaustive guide based on AMFI's official investor knowledge framework explaining Direct Plans in mutual funds. Discover how Direct Plans eliminate distributor commissions, why their NAV grows faster, mathematical compounding comparisons, and step-by-step switching strategies.
- [UTI Mutual Fund Dividend (IDCW) Scheme-Wise History & Payout Summary (April–September 2026): Complete Data, Yield Analysis & Tax Guide](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/uti-mutual-fund-dividend-idcw-scheme-wise-payout-summary-h1-2026): An exhaustive scheme-wise breakdown of UTI Mutual Fund's IDCW (dividend) payouts across 50 scheme options for H1 FY 2026-27 (1st April to 30th September 2026). Analyze payout percentages, per-unit dividend distributions, NAV impact, and tax implications under Section 194K.
- [Nifty 50 Index Funds vs Active Large-Cap Mutual Funds: Rolling Returns, TER Drag & Why Passive Investing Wins in India](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/nifty-50-index-funds-vs-active-large-cap-funds-rolling-returns-ter-drag): A comprehensive quantitative analysis of the Nifty 50 Index, how index funds work, and historical rolling return data comparing Nifty 50 index funds against actively managed large-cap mutual funds in India. Validate your own strategy using YieldNest's analytical tools.
- [UTI Mutual Fund Direct Plans: Performance Analysis Across Equity, Hybrid & Debt Schemes (September 2026)](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/uti-mutual-fund-direct-plans-performance-september-2026): Comprehensive performance analysis of 23 UTI Mutual Fund Direct Plan schemes as on 30th September 2026. Detailed 1Y, 3Y, 5Y, and 10Y CAGR tables across Multi Asset, Banking & PSU Debt, Corporate Bond, and Equity funds.
- [Consolidated Account Statement (CAS): How It Works, Who Issues It, and How to Track Your Portfolio](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/consolidated-account-statement-cas-guide): Official AMFI and SEBI guide to Consolidated Account Statements (CAS). Learn how NSDL, CDSL, CAMS, and KFintech consolidate mutual fund folios, dispatch schedules, e-CAS downloads, and folio troubleshooting.
- [AMFI Fund Performance Analysis: Large Cap, Flexi Cap, Mid Cap & Small Cap Comparison (October 2026)](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/amfi-fund-performance-comparison-large-mid-small-flexi-cap-october-2026): Official AMFI performance data across 220+ equity schemes and ₹25.45 Lakh Crores in AUM. Comprehensive 1-year, 3-year, and 5-year rolling returns, category median alpha, Direct vs Regular TER fee erosion, and comparative graphs.
- [Top Mutual Fund Myths Debunked: High NAV Fallacy, Dividend Traps & Market Timing](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/mutual-fund-myths-debunked-high-nav-dividend-traps-market-timing): Does a scheme with a ₹10 NAV give higher returns than one with a ₹500 NAV? Are dividends 'free money'? We dismantle the most pervasive mutual fund myths using empirical AMFI data and mathematical facts.
- [Why High Returns Don't Always Mean a Better Mutual Fund?](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/why-high-returns-dont-always-mean-better-mutual-fund): Understand the return-chasing trap: survivorship bias, excessive volatility, sector cyclicality, and why last year's top performer often becomes next year's laggard.
- [What Is Maximum Drawdown and Why Does It Matter?](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/what-is-maximum-drawdown-and-why-it-matters): Understand Maximum Drawdown (MDD): measuring peak-to-trough capital decline, recovery time, sequence of returns risk, and psychological resilience.
- [How to Evaluate Mutual Fund Risk: Beyond the Riskometer](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/how-to-evaluate-mutual-fund-risk): Master mutual fund risk evaluation: standard deviation, downside capture, maximum drawdown, credit concentration, and SEBI Riskometer limitations.
- [Alpha vs Beta in Mutual Funds: Understanding Outperformance and Risk](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/alpha-vs-beta-in-mutual-funds): Demystify modern portfolio theory: manager skill (Alpha) vs systematic market sensitivity (Beta), CAPM regression, and optimal risk positioning.
- [Sharpe Ratio vs Sortino Ratio: How Are They Different and Which Is Better?](https://www.yieldnest.online/article/sharpe-ratio-vs-sortino-ratio-difference): Understand risk-adjusted returns: Sharpe ratio's total volatility penalty vs Sortino ratio's focus on downside deviation, mathematical formulas, and analysis.
